source_metadata.title: Testosterone therapy in older men: clinical implications of recent landmark trials

extraction_limitations: The source is an invited narrative review, not primary original research. The current LiteratureAtom model is oriented toward primary literature and has no dedicated review-synthesis or recommendation atom kind.

Trial results are represented as findings reported by this review and tagged secondary_reported_result; they should not be treated as substitutes for LiteratureAtoms extracted directly from TEAAM, T-Trials, T4DM, or TRAVERSE primary publications.
The review explicitly notes that some outcomes are secondary or substudy analyses; those distinctions are retained where the source makes them clear.
The review is not a systematic review, so absence of a trial or outcome from this atom set should not be interpreted as evidence of absence in the broader testosterone literature.
Atoms remain review_status=needs_review because no human source-verification step was provided in this run.
schema_gaps: No dedicated atom kind exists for narrative-review synthesis, clinical-practice implication, or research-agenda recommendation; author_conclusion or limitation is used where defensible.
QuantitativeResult has one primary estimate and no first-class unit for that estimate; units and multi-arm context are therefore encoded in effect_measure and ArmObservation fields.
The model cannot explicitly identify the underlying cited primary publication for a secondary-reported result except through tags and statement text.
